name: The Hoard
fl: A torchlit service corridor. Every delver's first mistake happens here.
lore: Thirteen floors of plundered cellar, still warm from the last delver who tried. The Hoard keeps what it kills — and it isn't picky.

name: The Verdant Rot
fl: Something down here is still growing, and it resents the interruption.
lore: The lower cisterns drowned in moss a century ago. Spores map the walls in glowing veins; the guards breathe them, and what breathes them fights harder as it dies.

name: The Gilded Tomb
fl: Sealed doors, honest gold, dishonest odds.
lore: A burial vault built by people who took luck seriously: every urn is a wager, every step a coin toss the tomb has already won. Its keeper gambles with your life and rarely loses.

name: The Cracked Seam
fl: The picks are still here. The miners are not.
lore: A dwarven crystal seam abandoned mid-shift, ore carts loaded and rails humming. Whatever they dug into came out armoured, and it kept the tools.

name: The Jaguar Steps
fl: Old jade, older appetite — and it moves fast.
lore: Vines have taken the sun-shrine back, but the offerings are untouched: nobody who stoops to lift the jade stands up again. Its guardians hunt at a sprinter's pace.

name: The Sunken Watch
fl: Flooded to the ribs. Everything here has learned to wait.
lore: The cistern gates failed and never reopened; the garrison drowned standing at their posts and simply carried on. Cold water knits their wounds faster than you can open them.

name: The Ember Forge
fl: The fires never went out. Neither did the smith.
lore: A war-forge that outlived its war, hammering out blades for an army of ash. Everything drawn from that channel comes out sharper than it went in — including its keeper.

name: The Frostbound Cells
fl: Cold enough that dying takes its time.
lore: A prison level that froze with its inmates inside, mid-sentence. Ice is the only warden left — it armours what it holds and grudgingly gives it back.

name: The Orrery
fl: Brass, glass, and a very well-informed opponent.
lore: Someone built a machine to watch the sky from underground, then taught it to watch the doorway instead. It has run every version of this fight already and has opinions about your odds.

name: The Hoard-King's Court
fl: The portrait has been expecting you for some time.
lore: Green candles, a crowned corpse in gilt, and one chest with your name already inked on the manifest. The Hoard-King does not guard the treasure — he is the ledger it is written in.
